# Round 1 (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/a98b4c07-45f2-5d08-aa74-0c95b1e5e538/scratchpad/b6-PXD016521/validate_round1.txt): validate-sdrf 0, structure 0, check 0; reconcile 0 with one MINOR

#   reconcile's prose reader (sampleProcessingProtocol etc.) does not see. Fixed by passing the native PRIDE v3 record
#   (pride_v3.json); the protocol says "digested with trypsin" / "in-gel digested with trypsin" and reconcile agrees.
# Rounds 2-3: manifests written; schema-check 0, manifest-coverage 0 (sha256 complexome df4453f5..., ip 740607988...).
# Independent review (annotations/PXD016521.review.md): FAIL on both files, two IMPORTANT findings, fixed in the tables
#   and rebuilt (round 4 = final, below):
#   1. characteristics[developmental stage] 'adolescent stage' (HsapDv:0000086) is OBSOLETE in OLS4 (verified:
#      is_obsolete=true). Replaced by '13-year-old stage' (HsapDv:0000107, verified is_obsolete=false, matching Cellosaurus
#      AG 13Y). The earlier note claiming HsapDv:0000107 is_a adolescent stage is withdrawn (outdated).
#   2. Cybrid identity: added custom columns characteristics[cybrid nuclear parent] = '143B TK- rho0 (parental 143B,
#      CVCL_2270)' and characteristics[mitochondrial DNA donor] = 'heteroplasmic MT-CYB 4-bp deletion patient,
#      parkinsonism/MELAS overlap syndrome (de Coo 1999; Rana 2000)' (same value on WT and Δ4-CYB rows: paper "populated
#      with mitochondria from the same heteroplasmic patient"); manifest now states that sex/age/stage/ancestry/organism
#      part/osteosarcoma describe the nuclear donor only, and justifies keeping disease = osteosarcoma on all rows.
#   Minors addressed in the manifests: rule-16 justification for comment[fraction identifier] on BN-PAGE slices;
#   full-table N-term counts (scripts/nterm.py: Acetyl 15,542/15,715 and Formyl 5,005/5,062 PSMs at protein position
#   1/2 in UniProt human reviewed); IP intensity cross-check for reciprocal labelling (scripts/orient.py); PRO3980A13-A24
#   absent from the deposit recorded as a limitation. Channel maps, detergent, IP orientation and file mapping unchanged.
#
# ===== Explanations / refutations (final round)
# - validate-sdrf WARNING '13-year-old stage ... not found in efo': the term is HsapDv:0000107 (not obsolete; Cellosaurus
#   AG 13Y). EFO has no age-specific human developmental stage term (OLS exact search 'adolescent stage' in efo: 0 hits).
#   Same class of warning as the accepted 'fetal stage' (HsapDv) in campaign precedent PXD004666.
# - convert-openms exit 1 'Cannot read precursor mass tolerance: not available' (EXPECTED): neither search deposited its
#   parameters (no mqpar.xml/parameters.txt for the MaxQuant IP search; no .msf/.pdResult/Mascot .dat for the PD complexome
#   search) and neither paper nor PRIDE states tolerances, so the honest sentinel is kept (campaign precedent
#   PXD014368/PXD006676). The DIAGNOSTIC runs at the end convert scratch copies with placeholder tolerances: both succeed
#   (complexome: 4 conditions genotype x detergent; ip: 2 conditions), so nothing else blocks conversion. The complexome
#   'no TA= specified' warning concerns the PP=Protein N-term Acetyl/Formyl modifications (expected).
#
# ===== Round 4 (final)
